meta.title: Peak Clock
meta.description: DeepSeek charges full price during peak hours and half price outside them. Peak Clock shows which window is in effect right now, with the time left, a local-day timeline, the published price table, your Platform balance and this session's spend. The badge sits in the composer next to the model selector; click it for the detail panel. Peak hours are 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays; everything else is off-peak. Prices in USD per 1M tokens and the spend apply only to models DeepSeek serves directly, and the spend is an estimate priced at the request's settlement time; the account balance is shown in its own currency (CNY or USD) for any provider. The balance and the spend need the DeepSeek account service and a signed-in account; without them the clock keeps working. The holiday calendar ships for 2026-2027, is fetched from public mirrors for later years, and falls back to weekdays only, with an explicit warning, when every mirror fails.
